UpdateStageName: Prepare S1DS data directories and environment file
UpdateSourceArgs:
-c "mkdir -p '{{$FullRootDir}}game' '{{$FullRootDir}}steamcmd' '{{$FullRootDir}}steamhome'; setfacl -R -m u:1000:rwX -m d:u:1000:rwX -m u:$(id -u):rwX -m d:u:$(id -u):rwX '{{$FullRootDir}}game' '{{$FullRootDir}}steamcmd' '{{$FullRootDir}}steamhome' 2>/dev/null || true; if [ ! -f '{{$FullRootDir}}steamcmd/steamcmd.sh' ]; then docker run --rm -v '{{$FullRootDir}}steamcmd:/mnt' --entrypoint /bin/sh ghcr.io/ifbars/s1dedicatedservers:{{ImageTag}} -c 'cp -a /home/steam/steamcmd/. /mnt/'; fi; docker run --rm --entrypoint /bin/cat ghcr.io/ifbars/s1dedicatedservers:{{ImageTag}} /home/steam/run.sh > '{{$FullRootDir}}run.sh.orig' && sed 's#^    --steam-gs-anonymous$#    --steam-gs-anonymous
    --stdio-console#' '{{$FullRootDir}}run.sh.orig' > '{{$FullRootDir}}run.sh' && chmod +x '{{$FullRootDir}}run.sh'; printf 'S1DS_RUNTIME=%s
STEAM_USER=%s
STEAM_PASS=%s
STEAM_GUARD=%s
FORCE_STEAMCMD_UPDATE=false
' '{{Runtime}}' '{{SteamUser}}' '{{SteamPass}}' '{{SteamGuard}}' > '{{$FullRootDir}}s1ds.env' && chmod 600 '{{$FullRootDir}}s1ds.env'; docker rm -f s1ds-server >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; CFG='{{$FullRootDir}}game/UserData/server_config.toml'; if [ -f $CFG ]; then sed -i 's#^serverName = .*#serverName = \x27{{ServerName}}\x27#; s#^serverPassword = .*#serverPassword = \x27{{ServerPassword}}\x27#; s#^maxPlayers = .*#maxPlayers = {{$MaxUsers}}#; s#^steamGameServerQueryPort = .*#steamGameServerQueryPort = 27018#' $CFG; fi"
